paragraphs.text: Coireall was a city or nation during the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria .

Although its exact location is unknown, Coireall was a city or nation on the continent of Terisiare during the Dark Age . At some point, Coireall developed the technology to build massive siege towers, which it used to assail the city walls of its rivals. The towers were able to transport soldiers over the lip of the walls using hooked gangplanks. The towers also included apertures for pouring boiling oil over the defenders by extending and tipping cauldrons over the edge of the wall, effectively negating the wall's defenses.
References to Coireall are only found during the Dark Age, and it is likely that it, like most other nations on Terisiare , fell around the Start of the Ice Age .
